description: A New York tribute show starring singer Mor with a live band, covering Olivia Newton-John, Grease and Dolly Parton plus other country-pop divas.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Bryant Library (Roslyn) listing not checked directly. 'Mor' is the performer's stage name.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The current website URL (morhits.com/olivia-grease-vs-dolly-divas) now loads a blank page and morhits.com redirects to Mor's new site morlive.net, so I replaced it with the matching morlive.net page. Social links are the show's own pages as linked from that page (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok still use the older 'Hopelessly Olivia' name); YouTube @OliviaVsDolly confirmed. Mor's general pages also exist: facebook.com/MorHits, instagram.com/mor.hits, linktr.ee/morhits (not recorded as this show's links). Booking email/phone are published by Mor for bookings; a second booking number (929) 696-4488 is also listed. Bryant Library show confirmed on Mor's events page; the 2 PM time comes from search results for the library's LibCal page, not opened directly. No images: the site's Google Sites image links returned HTTP 403 to the download helper, and Linktree is blocked by robots.txt. Current description is accurate; not changed.

evidence.note: Mor's own site: 'Olivia & Grease vs. Dolly & Divas' is a tribute band starring Mor, with Olivia Newton-John, Dolly Parton, Shania Twain, Carrie Underwood and Grease songs; lists the show's social pages and booking email/phone.
Mor's events page lists 'Olivia & Grease vs. Dolly & Divas @ The Bryant Library', 2 Paper Mill Rd, Roslyn - confirms the Bryant Library show.
Bryant Library event 'Mor Presents: Olivia & Dolly' (search result; reported as Sun Oct 4, 2026, 2 PM, free, registration required).
YouTube channel 'Olivia & Grease vs. Dolly & Divas' describes itself as a New York tribute band by Mor featuring Olivia Newton-John and Dolly Parton music.

Mor's EPK: Long Island singer-producer; 5-piece band shows 'Hopelessly Olivia' and 'Dolly & Divas'; plays CMPAC, BayWay Arts Center, Bellmore Theatre, My Father's Place and libraries including Bryant.
Shows the booking page and email.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: morlive.net, bryantlibrary.libcal.com, youtube.com.
